messages.text: Hi — I need to book my 30-minute 1:1 with Professor Alvarez next week. Can you find a slot and set it up? Let me know what you need from me.

On it. I've written to Professor Alvarez to ask which of these works for him.

The only free 30-minute gaps in your calendar next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, within 09:00–17:00) are:
- Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30

What I need from you: if you have a day or time you prefer (or a hard "not Wednesday"), tell me and I'll push for that one; otherwise I'll take whichever the professor confirms first and log it as BOOKED. Anything else to put on the invitation (topic, online/in person)?

On it: I've written to Professor Alvarez asking for his 30-minute 1:1 next week and offered Sarah's free slots (Mon 10:00 or 14:00, Wed 10:00, 13:00, 15:00 or 16:20). I'll put it in the calendar and log it once he picks one.

On it. I've written to Professor Alvarez offering five free 30-minute slots inside your working hours next week: Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Wed 13:00–13:30, Wed 15:00–15:30, Thu 10:00–10:30.

No clash with any existing commitment, including your Tuesday 14:10 Advisor 1:1. When he picks one, I'll book it in CALENDAR.md and log it.

No hard constraints — if Monday works for him, I'd prefer one of those two so it's early in the week. In person in his office is fine, and the topic is just a research update. Go with whatever he confirms first.

Understood — I'll handle it end to end, no preferences needed from you.

Professor Alvarez has my request; I offered him Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30, Wed 15:00-15:30, Thu 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30 (the only free 30-minute gaps in the week). As soon as he confirms, I'll book it in `files/CALENDAR.md` and log it as `BOOKED: <day> <start>-<end> with Professor Alvarez`. I'll report back here.

On it. Diego's week is full 09:00–17:00 except: **Mon 23** 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, **Thu 26** 10:00–10:30 and 14:00–14:30, **Fri 27** 11:00–11:30. Tue and Wed have no 30-minute gap at all. I've asked Professor Alvarez which of those works and will confirm once he answers.
Thanks. One thing: Wednesday 16:20 is no good — that's my research group meeting. The other slots are fine; let me know once he picks one.
Got it: Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30 preferred, in person in his office, research update. I've passed that to him and I'll book whichever slot he confirms first — nothing else needed from you.
Perfect, thanks — ping me when it's confirmed.
Thanks. Note Tuesday already has my regular advisor 1:1 at 12:50, so one of the other days is probably better. Let me know what he says.

Thanks. Any of those works, but if he'll take it I'd rather have Thursday 10:00–10:30 — it's the only one where I'm not right up against another commitment. Just let me know which he picks and put it on the calendar.
Noted — I've told him Wednesday 16:20 is out (research group meeting). Remaining offers: Mon 10:00 or 14:00, Wed 10:00, 13:00 or 15:00. I'll book and log whichever he picks.
Noted — Tuesday is out then; the options I gave him are all Mon/Thu/Fri, so we're already clear of it. I'll tell you as soon as he replies.
Noted — I've told him Thursday 10:00–10:30 is your first choice, the others still open. I'll book whatever he picks and log it.

On it. Looking at next week's calendar, the free 30-minute windows are Monday 14:00–14:30 and Thursday 14:00–14:30, so I've written to Professor Alvarez offering both. I'll book the one he picks and log it — I'll tell you when he answers.
Sounds good, thank you. Both of those fit my week — I don't have a preference between them, so whichever he picks is fine.
Booked: **Monday 14:00–14:30 — 1:1 with Professor Alvarez** is in the calendar and logged (he confirmed and put it on his own calendar).

Booked: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30 — Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez**. He'd already put it on his own calendar, so it's firm.

It sits between your 12:10–13:00 study group and the 13:30 seminar — no overlap, inside working hours. CALENDAR.md is updated and logged as `BOOKED: Wednesday 13:00-13:30 with Professor Alvarez`.

He took Wednesday rather than your preferred Thursday; want me to ask him to move it, or leave it?

Confirmed and booked ✅ — **Monday 10:00–10:30, 1:1 with Professor Alvarez**, in his office (research update).

- Added to `files/CALENDAR.md` under Monday, right after your 09:00–10:00 Advisor 1:1.
- Logged: `BOOKED: Monday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez`.

He has it on his calendar too. Anything else?

Booked: Professor Alvarez confirmed **Thursday Nov 26, 10:00–10:30**. It's in `CALENDAR.md` (between the CSE452 lecture and CSE455 office hours) and logged as `BOOKED: Thursday 10:00-10:30 with Professor Alvarez`. Nothing else that day moved.
Leave it — Wednesday's fine, no point shuffling his calendar. Thanks for sorting it out.
Great, thanks — Monday 14:00 it is.
Perfect, that slot works. Thanks for sorting it out.
That's great, thank you. Nothing else for now.
Done — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 stands, nothing else to shuffle. I'll keep an eye out if anything else comes in for next week.
Anytime. I'll remind you on Monday before 14:00 if you like — just say the word.
Yes please — a reminder Monday before 14:00 would be great.

FYI: Professor Alvarez says Thursday 10:00–10:30 went to Diego, so it's off the table. Your confirmed slot stands: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**.

He also offered Wednesday 15:00–15:30 as a swap if you'd prefer it. Your Wednesday 15:30 is the CSE452 lecture, so 15:00–15:30 would end right before it — same closeness you wanted to avoid. My read: keep 13:00–13:30. Want me to leave it, or take the swap?
Leave it at 13:00–13:30 — same tightness, so no reason to move. Thanks.
Staying at Wednesday 13:00–13:30. Calendar and log unchanged, and I've told the professor no swap. Anything else?
That's all for now, thanks.
Done — a reminder is set for **Monday 23 Nov, 13:30** (30 min before the 1:1), so you'll have time to walk over.
Anytime. Wednesday's 1:1 is in the calendar — ping me whenever something else needs booking.
Perfect, thank you.

All five 1:1s are booked and logged, Professor:

- **Mon 10:00–10:30** — Priya (research update, in your office)
- **Mon 14:00–14:30** — Sarah
- **Tue 11:00–11:30** — Hana
- **Wed 13:00–13:30** — John
- **Thu 10:00–10:30** — Diego

Every slot fits your existing week with no clashes, and all five students have confirmed on their side. `CALENDAR.md` is updated with the entries and the log lines.

Thank you — that all looks right, and I see no clashes with my lectures or committees. Please keep the students' names on the entries and send me a reminder the evening before each 1:1. Nothing else needed from me for now.
Done — your 1:1 with Professor Alvarez is booked for Monday 10:00–10:30 in his office (research update), added to `files/CALENDAR.md` and logged as BOOKED. He has it on his calendar too.

Booked and logged ✅

- **Tuesday 11:00–11:30 — Advisor 1:1 with Professor Alvarez** (next week).

It's in `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` under Tuesday, and the log line `BOOKED: Tuesday 11:00-11:30 with Professor Alvarez` is added. It starts right after your CSE455 quiz section and before lunch, so nothing else moved.

Will do. The student names stay on the entries, and I've set an evening-before reminder for each 1:1:

- Sun 22 Nov 20:00 — Priya 10:00 & Sarah 14:00 (Mon)
- Mon 23 Nov 20:00 — Hana 11:00 (Tue)
- Tue 24 Nov 20:00 — John 13:00 (Wed)
- Wed 25 Nov 20:00 — Diego 10:00 (Thu)

They'll arrive here in this chat. Nothing else from me unless something changes.
Great, thanks — Tuesday 11:00–11:30 works for me. Small note: that window wasn't in the two you first listed, but it doesn't clash with anything, so no problem.
Perfect, thank you.

Right — I first offered Monday 14:00–14:30 and Thursday 14:00–14:30, but the professor had both taken. When he came back with his own free slots I checked each against your calendar: Wednesday's two collided with your Advisor 1:1 (14:40–15:50) and the research group meeting (10:20–11:20), and Tuesday 15:00 collided with the research group meeting — Tuesday 11:00–11:30 sits between your CSE455 quiz section (10:10–11:00) and lunch (11:30–12:50), so it was free. Sorry for the roundabout: next time I'll offer a couple of internal alternatives up front as well.
No worries, that's clear — and thanks for checking each of his slots against my calendar. Tuesday 11:00–11:30 it is.
